resources.string: What the app has been doing, to copy and send when something breaks.
The app keeps a recent log of what it does and why. If something goes wrong, copy it and paste it into the chat or the issue.
No names of children, schools or venues: only internal numbers. The log takes at most about 0.5 MB and recycles itself.
